transcript: Last night, my boyfriend Paul and I went to see Gray House on Broadway. A new horror, suspense, psychological thriller kind of play. Not gonna spoil anything about the plot, especially because things could change between now and opening night, but I was pretty into it for the most part, and it surprised me in multiple ways. The play set in 1977, but the script feels modern and witty. And there are actually quite a few times throughout the play where the audience was laughing. There are definitely some creepy moments, but I don't feel like it's a super in your face scarefest kind of thing. But it does keep you on the edge of your seat because there's a lot for you as an audience member to try to dissect and figure out. I honestly tend to struggle with this kind of thing, so I wouldn't have minded if the play handed out a few more clues to us. But even though I don't think I caught every single little thing, it was still definitely enjoyable and not the kind of theater experience you get to have on Broadway very often. With that, another playbill for my collection.
